faq.heading: Common questions
faq.whatIsModalAnswer: The modal price is the rate at which most of the day's volume actually traded. It is a more realistic guide to what you will be paid than the maximum price, which usually reflects a small quantity of the very best grade.
faq.howOften: How often are these rates updated?
faq.howOftenAnswer: The Government of India's feed refreshes roughly once an hour on trading days. This page shows the latest published figures along with the time they were read.
faq.whyMissingAnswer: A mandi only appears on days it trades and submits a report. Sunday and holiday closures, and delayed reporting, both show up as missing rows rather than as zero prices.
faq.unitQuestion: Are prices per kg or per quintal?
faq.unitAnswer: The official feed publishes rupees per quintal (100 kg). Use the unit switch to see the same rate per kg or per 50 kg bag.

footer.disclaimer: Prices are published by the Directorate of Marketing & Inspection (Agmarknet) via data.gov.in and are shown as received. Verify with your mandi before trading.
